# Fossify Commons 7.1.3 (vendored, GPL-3.0)

Source: https://github.com/FossifyOrg/commons tag 7.1.3. Local changes for uMessage:

- `BaseSimpleActivity`: removed the "fake version of the app" warning (onCreate and startCustomizationActivity).
- `Activity.checkAppSideloading()` always returns false; `Context.fakeVersionCheck()` is a no-op.
- `samples` module dropped from `settings.gradle.kts`.
- `appLaunched` no longer switches launcher-icon aliases (the icon never changes).
- Letter avatar colours use the uMessage palette; `getContrastColor()` uses WCAG contrast; `BaseConfig.resetThemeColors()` added.
- `BaseSimpleActivity` only registers its `OnBackPressedCallback` for subclasses that override `onBackPressedCompat()` (found by name; kept in `consumer-rules.pro`). An always-enabled callback blocked the system predictive back animation on every screen.
- App lock: `helpers/AppLockSecurity.kt` stores the PIN/pattern as salted PBKDF2-SHA256 of the old SHA-1 entry hash. The security dialog tabs verify through it (`BaseSecurityTab.matchesEntry`) and still accept an old bare SHA-1 value. Waiting no longer resets the wrong-entry count: from the 3rd wrong entry on, each starts a wait that doubles (5 s up to 1 h), kept in the config across restarts; only a correct entry resets it. Wrong repeats while setting up a new credential are not counted.
- App lock, wave 4: `AppLockSecurity` binds new stored values to the phone (`pbkdf2-sha256-device$...`: the PBKDF2 output HMAC'd with a non-exportable Android Keystore key, `AppLockSecurity.deviceBinding`); bare SHA-1 and plain PBKDF2 values still verify and are replaced after the next correct entry, and plain PBKDF2 is kept where the Keystore does not work. `AppLockManager` takes a clock for tests, exposes `isUnlockExpired` (a timeout of 0 means lock as soon as the app is left; a clock that went backwards locks) and no longer re-locks right after `unlock()`. `BaseConfig` gains `appLockCredentialWeak` and `appLockBlockScreenshots` (default off). `showBiometricPrompt` gains an `errorCallback` with the error code, and `isPermanentBiometricError()` says when to fall back to the PIN. Tests live in the app (`AppLockDeviceBindingTest`, `AppLockTimeoutTest`, `AppLockSessionTest`, `AppLockLogicTest`).
- App lock, own pickers: `AppLockManager.allowOwnTrip()` is called just before the app opens a system screen of its own for a result (file picker, camera). Leaving the app for it within 10 s, and coming back within 2 minutes, does not lock it, even with "lock immediately"; it covers one trip only (`AppLockTimeoutTest`).
- `isBiometricIdAvailable()` returns false (instead of throwing) when the merged manifest lacks `USE_BIOMETRIC`.
- App lock screen: `AppLockActivity`, `AppLockAdapter` and `activity_app_lock.xml` are removed. The app provides its own lock screen through `FossifyApp.appUnlockActivity`, which `maybeLaunchAppUnlockActivity` (now in `activities/AppUnlock.kt`) starts; `FossifyApp` refuses to start when `isAppLockFeatureAvailable` is true without one.
- App lock scope (I44): `FossifyApp.screenNeedsAppLock(activity)` (default true) is asked by `maybeLaunchAppUnlockActivity` before it starts the lock screen, so an app can lock only some screens. uMessage answers false for every screen but the Blocked ones when "only chosen parts" is on; the lock state and timeout (`AppLockManager`) are untouched.
- Blocked numbers: `isNumberBlockedByPattern()` treats only `*` as a wildcard (everything else literal) and skips a malformed entry instead of throwing; `isNumberBlocked()` compares two numbers that both carry a country code in full instead of by their last 9 digits.
- Joda-Time removed (CM-21): `getDateTimeFromDateString()` returns a `java.time.LocalDate` (two-digit years still read as 1950-2049) and `getDayOfWeekString()` uses `java.time.DayOfWeek` numbers; the dependency and its shrinker rules are gone.
- `settings.gradle.kts`: JitPack is limited to `com.github.tibbi` (Reprint) with `exclusiveContent`, as in the app's settings, so no other dependency can come from it (QD-31, F-Droid).
